title: Agora product materials document AUSD as an active fully reserved digital dollar
description: Current Agora product and legal materials identify AUSD, Agora Bermuda Limited as issuer, par redemption for eligible verified customers, and a reserve model including short-term U.S. Treasuries, overnight repo, cash, and other liquid assets.
notes: This is a current-state documentation event and is not substituted for the unresolved original first-mint or launch date.

title: Agora stops new AUSD issuance on Injective and begins network wind-down
description: Agora announced that no new AUSD would be minted on Injective from April 3, 2026, while redemptions would remain available through September 28, 2026; residual claims after that date would still be honored subject to enhanced verification and possible fees.
notes: This event is network-scoped. It does not imply AUSD-wide discontinuation; current Agora deployment documentation continues to list multiple active mainnets.
